documentos.resumen: Scrum with two-week sprints in all ten teams. Code review is mandatory. Platform and Digital Channels report to the same technology director.
Vendor North runs Payments and Mobile App; Vendor South runs Lending. Both work on a capacity basis (fixed FTE per month), with no commitment on lead times.
Payments changed its QA vendor in September. Mobile App is in the middle of a large release. Identity started using Jira in August.
